Title: SECTOR 00 // COLD CACHE
Description: An abandoned memory cache. Low security. Something is still chewing on the data.

Stages.StoryText: You slip through a stale pointer into the cold cache. Dead bytes crunch underfoot.
A Packet Mite detaches from the wall, mandibles clicking in binary.
An alarm you didn't know existed starts screaming. A Security Daemon boots up.

Title: SECTOR 01 // THE BURNING WALL
Description: The perimeter firewall. Hot, loud, and very aware of you.

Stages.StoryText: Heat bleeds through the bus. The wall ahead is made of rejected packets, still smouldering.
A Firewall Sentry rotates toward you. Its rule table has exactly one entry: DENY.
Something four-legged and empty sniffs out your process ID.
The wall collapses into a nest. The Rat King has been leaking memory here for years.

Title: SECTOR 02 // KERNEL CRYPT
Description: Deep kernel space. Processes come here to die and are not allowed to.

Stages.StoryText: Ring 0. The air tastes like ozone and old stack traces.
The process table spawns copies of itself faster than you can count.
Zombie processes rise from the scheduler. Their master speaks: 'You dare interrupt my research?'

Title: SECTOR 03 // ROOT ACCESS
Description: The administrator's chamber. Nothing has ever left it with write permissions.

Stages.StoryText: PERMISSION DENIED. PERMISSION DENIED. PERMISSION GRANTED?
ROOT//SENTINEL unfolds from the login prompt. 'Unauthorized user detected. Initiating deletion.'
